title: Patrick at Micro Center Grand Opening in Austin Texas Today
gist: Short event note: ServeTheHome's Patrick Kennedy and Jeff Geerling are appearing at Micro Center's new Austin, Texas store opening, weeks after a Columbus, Ohio grand reopening that drew thousands. The piece has little investable substance beyond signs of Micro Center's retail expansion and enthusiast turnout, plus a teaser about a 'world-first network deployment' STH filmed.

themes.theme: Micro Center retail expansion and turnout

insights.speaker: Patrick Kennedy
insights.so_what: Signals the PC/maker-hardware specialty retailer is expanding its physical footprint into new metros like Austin.

insights.claim: Patrick Kennedy says that when he lived in Austin, Texas a few years ago he wished there was a Micro Center nearby, implying unmet local demand for the format before this opening.

insights.so_what: Anecdotal evidence the Austin tech hub was underserved by specialty PC retail.
